facts.en: Earned an archive support diploma at Fictional Quillshore College in 2023.
facts.zh: 2023 年在虚构羽岸学院获得档案支持文凭。

facts.en: Paid digitization assistant at Fictional Cedarvoice Heritage Centre from 2024-01 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2024-01 至 2026-08 在虚构雪松声遗产中心任有薪数字化助理。

facts.en: Transfers assigned oral-history audio carriers using the centre’s approved workstation settings and handling instructions.
facts.zh: 使用中心获批工作站设置及操作说明，转录分配的口述历史音频载体。

facts.en: Records carrier labels, file identifiers and capture-session notes in the collection register.
facts.zh: 在馆藏登记册记录载体标签、文件编号及采集会话备注。

facts.en: Checks whether captured files open and compares their beginning and ending against the source carrier.
facts.zh: 检查采集文件能否打开，并将其开头及结尾与源载体比较。

facts.en: The audio specialist sets restoration methods; the archivist approves descriptive records and public access status.
facts.zh: 音频专家设定修复方法；档案馆员批准描述记录及公开访问状态。

facts.en: Helped digitize a 2025-05 pilot group of 32 audio cassettes.
facts.zh: 协助将一批 2025-05 试点的 32 盒录音带数字化。

facts.en: The pilot produced 61 capture files because several cassettes required separate side or segment files.
facts.zh: 该试点生成 61 个采集文件，因为数盒录音带需要分成不同磁带面或片段文件。

facts.en: Personally transferred 14 cassettes; another assistant handled the remaining 18 cassettes.
facts.zh: 个人转录 14 盒录音带；另一名助理处理其余 18 盒。

facts.en: The source does not state that the 61 capture files represent 61 unique interviews or that all were publicly released.
facts.zh: 资料未说明 61 个采集文件代表 61 次不同访谈，亦未说明全部公开发布。

facts.en: Flags unreadable labels and conflicting donor descriptions for archival review rather than silently correcting them.
facts.zh: 标记无法辨读的标签及相互冲突的捐赠者描述，交由档案人员审核，而不在未作说明的情况下自行更正。

facts.en: For one pilot cassette, the carrier label states 1988 and its donor list states 1989; the interview year remains unresolved.
facts.zh: 试点中一盒录音带的载体标签写明 1988，捐赠者清单写明 1989；访谈年份尚未确定。

facts.en: Uses audio capture software, file checksum tools and spreadsheet collection registers.
facts.zh: 使用音频采集软件、文件校验和工具及电子表格馆藏登记册。

facts.en: Compares copied-file checksums after transfer to managed storage and records any mismatch for technical review.
facts.zh: 文件转存至受管理存储后比较副本校验和，并记录不匹配情况供技术审核。

facts.en: Completed internal carrier handling and file-storage induction in 2024-01.
facts.zh: 2024-01 完成内部载体操作及文件存储入职培训。

facts.en: Volunteered with Fictional Storyquay Memory Club in 2022, arranging chairs and collecting event feedback cards.
facts.zh: 2022 年在虚构故事码头记忆社做志愿者，摆放椅子并收集活动反馈卡。

facts.en: Recorded a personal 12-minute fictional family-history play in 2024 with 2 relatives.
facts.zh: 2024 年与 2 名亲属录制个人 12 分钟虚构家族史短剧。

facts.en: Personally assembled the audio clips; relatives wrote and performed the fictional dialogue.
facts.zh: 个人拼接音频片段；亲属撰写并表演虚构对白。

facts.en: The play was shared privately and was not part of the heritage centre’s archival collection.
facts.zh: 该短剧仅私下分享，不属于遗产中心档案馆藏。

facts.en: Enjoys making paper cassette-box illustrations and listening to instrumental music.
facts.zh: 爱好绘制纸质磁带盒插画及聆听器乐。

facts.en: Maintains daily handovers listing untransferred carriers, label questions and files awaiting access review.
facts.zh: 维护每日交接，列明未转录载体、标签问题及待访问权限审核文件。

facts.en: No independent authority to clear copyright or authorize public release is recorded.
facts.zh: 未记录独立办理版权许可或授权公开发布的权限。
